sections.heading: C — Knowledge dossier: Basic driving
sections.markdown:
## C — Knowledge dossier: Basic driving

FACT_ID: sec08-F01 | anchor: A29
Use the owner’s manual for the vehicle’s starting procedure. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F02 | anchor: A29
In the handbook’s Park-selector starting procedure, put the right foot on the brake, confirm Park and apply the parking brake before starting. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F03 | anchor: A29
The keyed-ignition procedure calls for inserting the key, turning the ignition on and checking the warning lights and gauges. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F04 | anchor: A29
A manual-transmission vehicle must be out of gear for starting, and some vehicles also require the clutch to be pressed. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F05 | anchor: A29
Before pulling away in Drive, check for a clear path ahead and traffic beside and behind the vehicle. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F06 | anchor: A29
Signal before moving off, then press the accelerator gently only when moving is safe. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F07 | anchor: A29
Accelerate smoothly using the upper part of the foot on the pedal and the heel on the floor. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F08 | anchor: A29
Starting too abruptly can spin the driven wheels and make the vehicle slide, particularly on a slippery surface. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F09 | anchor: A29
In a manual-shift vehicle, coordinate the clutch and accelerator while changing gears to avoid over-revving or stalling. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F10 | anchor: A29
Before stopping, check the rearview mirrors, transfer the foot from accelerator to brake and brake with steady pressure until stopped. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F11 | anchor: A29
Anticipate stopping needs because abrupt braking can cause a skid or loss of control and make it harder for following drivers to avoid a rear-end crash. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F12 | anchor: A29
Looking ahead may allow earlier slowing or a lane change instead of a panic stop. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F13 | anchor: A29
Turn the steering wheel toward the direction the vehicle should move, whether traveling forward or in reverse. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F14 | anchor: A29
Look well ahead and toward both road edges so steering needs can be recognized before reaching them. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F15 | anchor: A29
The handbook recommends both hands outside the wheel at the 3-and-9 positions. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F16 | anchor: A29
The handbook no longer recommends the 2-and-10 hand position because of its danger in an air-bag-equipped vehicle. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F17 | anchor: A29
Grip the wheel firmly but gently with the fingers rather than palms, keeping the thumbs upward along its face. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F18 | anchor: A29
Never steer by gripping the inside of the steering wheel. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F19 | anchor: A29
Use hand-over-hand steering for sharp corners and return the wheel straight by hand rather than letting it slide through the fingers. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F20 | anchor: A29
Never turn the ignition to Lock while the vehicle is moving because the steering can lock during a turn and cause loss of control. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec08-F21 | anchor: A29
Check the speedometer often and obey posted limits, especially after leaving a fast road for slower local streets. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0029]

Misconceptions: Mirrors do not reveal the area immediately behind the vehicle; steering follows the intended vehicle direction even in reverse; never engage the ignition lock while moving.
Mnemonics: Use prepare, look, signal and move as an authored cue without replacing the vehicle manual.
Glossary: Park and reverse are the selector positions described in the source; hand-over-hand describes the cited sharp-corner technique; a steering lock is different from merely stopping the engine.
Dynamic facts: Starting controls and clutch interlocks vary by vehicle; follow the applicable owner’s manual rather than assume every vehicle has the pictured controls.

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Prepare, observe and move smoothly; preserve safe steering and backing posture.

items.why: Starting, stopping, steering and reversing require distinct practice sequences.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
